name: People-Clothing-Segmentation
description: The People-Clothing-Segmentation dataset evaluates image segmentation models on the task of isolating clothing regions worn by people. Each sample provides an input photograph and a text prompt, and the model must produce a pixel-level segmentation mask of the clothing areas.
card_text: This dataset contains 200 image–text pairs for people clothing segmentation. The input consists of an everyday photograph (input.image_file) and a short instruction (input.prompt) that asks to 'Segment out the people clothing area in the image'. The target output is a segmentation mask image (output.map_file) where clothing pixels are highlighted. Images typically show people in various poses and settings, and the mask delineates all clothing items worn by them. The dataset tests a model's ability to understand a textual instruction and perform fine-grained pixel-level segmentation of clothing regions, requiring both visual recognition of garments and precise spatial localization. Assumptions include the presence of at least one person with visible clothing and a consistent mask format.

image.semantics: Reference to the input photograph containing people and their clothing; the model must segment clothing regions from this image.

question.semantics: A short instruction telling the model to segment out the people clothing area in the provided image.

mask.semantics: Reference to the output segmentation mask image that highlights the clothing regions of people in the input image.

meta.meta_structure_description: Each sample contains an input image (input.image_file), a textual instruction prompt (input.prompt) that asks to segment clothing, and an output segmentation mask image (output.map_file). The prompt refers to the input image, and the mask is the target visual output indicating pixel-level clothing regions.
